title: ui: the record:discussion panel can never offer the declared FeedFilterMode `changes_only` — it sits only on authored pages, and field-history context is filled only on synthesized pages
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQTVjryTSkqydKVS6z

Filing gate: (b) an out-of-scope finding a card dev measured. Source: PR #33990 (#33963, batch A of the v18.5.0 sweep close-out #33761), Acceptance notes, ledger row 149 of anchor comment 6896511848. ⛔ Not a claim.

class: b · reach: an app author who authors a record page with a `record:discussion` panel and sets (or lets a user pick) the feed filter `changes_only`; the value is declared in the spec and documented, but on that surface it is never offered.

## What was read (origin/main `895783a1`, re-checked by the seat on current main)

- `packages/spec/src/data/feed.zod.ts:54` declares `'changes_only'` as a FeedFilterMode value; `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:887` lists it in the panel's enum.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` (~L226–238) offers `changes_only` only when `RecordFieldHistoryContext` says the record shows its field history; a `changes_only` no longer offered reads as All Activity (plugin-detail CHANGELOG).
- Per the dev's reading, RecordDetailView fills that context (its `historyPage`, reading `sys_audit_log`) only for a synthesized page, and a `record:discussion` panel always sits on an authored page. So no fixture can open the `changes_only` leg of `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` acceptance[7]; the checklist keeps it `blocked(fixture)`.

## Ask (for the lane triage picks)

Decide whether this is declared ≠ enforced on the panel (the authored-page panel should be able to read field history and offer `changes_only`), or intended (the value belongs to the synthesized stream only, and the spec/panel prose should say so). Either way the checklist leg follows the answer.

Dedupe: searched `changes_only` (code, CHANGELOGs) and open issues for `changes_only record:discussion`; the related history is objectstack#30074 (ruling C, what Changes holds), which does not cover reachability on authored pages.
